title: Square to the Star
brief: Steer the blue square with the joystick to the star while a red circle patrols the middle; touching the circle loses, reaching the star wins.

title: Shrinking Dot
brief: Tap the pink dot before it shrinks and jumps away; 8 taps win, 3 misses or taps on the grey decoy lose.

title: Falling Blocks
brief: Slide a paddle left and right to dodge falling blocks; 10 dodged blocks win, one hit loses.

title: Coin Catch
brief: Drag a basket to catch falling coins; 12 caught win, 3 dropped lose.

title: Tap Counter
brief: Tap the green button 20 times within 12 seconds to win.

title: Bouncing Ball
brief: Tap the ball as it bounces off walls and a bumper; 5 taps win, 25 seconds without them loses.

title: Wolf Chase
brief: Run with the joystick from a chasing wolf; surviving 20 seconds wins, being caught loses.

title: Whack the Squares
brief: Tap the yellow squares that pop up before they vanish and avoid the bombs; 10 hits win, 3 mistakes lose.

title: Balloon Pop
brief: Tap rising balloons before they reach the spikes; 15 popped win, one reaching the spikes loses.

title: Star Grab
brief: Drag the square to the star as it keeps jumping to new spots, avoiding a bouncing rock; 8 stars win, a rock hit loses.

title: Right or Wrong
brief: Tap the green circle and never the red one; 6 right taps win, going 3 below zero loses.

title: Paddle Ball
brief: Keep a ball bouncing on a draggable paddle; 10 paddle hits win, hitting the floor loses.

title: Key and Door
brief: Steer with the joystick, take the key to open the door, dodge a patrolling bat and reach the exit.

title: Lava Crossing
brief: Cross the screen with the joystick through two sliding lava bars to the far bank; lava touch loses.

title: Swipe Sailor
brief: Swipe to steer a sailor in steps to the treasure chest, avoiding a rock and the screen edge.

title: Cannon Dodge
brief: Slide up and down to dodge cannonballs and grab 6 coins; a cannonball hit loses.
